description: This file defines interfaces and notifiers for the PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) entity in a wireless communication stack, including classes for transmitting side notifications, control interfaces, and data handling, following a specific naming convention for upper/lower layers and control/data purposes.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_lower_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the lower layers about new PDUs and discard requests in the transmitting side of PDCP.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_lower_interface
classes.description: Interface for informing the PDCP about transmit and delivery events, and buffer size handling.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_upper_data_interface
classes.description: Interface for upper layers to pass SDUs into the PDCP transmit entity.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_upper_control_interface
classes.description: Interface for configuring security, recovery, re-establishment, buffering, and flow control in PDCP.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_upper_control_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying upper layers about protocol failures, max count reached, and resume requirements.
